field_gloss.id: stable snake_case id, referenced by the vow field in the VOW-TAKEN log line
field_gloss.name: player-facing name
field_gloss.god_face: one of the six Storyteller chairs: Administrator | Engineer | Walker | Unstuck | Guide | Turtle
field_gloss.vm_cost: Virtue-Marks charged when this boon is picked inside the Third Way Initiation (the ledger economy F1 scores)
field_gloss.vow_eligible: true if a Vow may be sworn on this boon; false boons can never be vowed
field_gloss.vow_multiplier: effect multiplier while the Vow is kept; null when vow_eligible is false
field_gloss.seed_locked: true = the boon's randomness is locked to the session seed, peeking is impossible; false = the boon exposes a peek-legal roll surface (canon-priced)

design_decisions: Unstuck-face boons are vow_eligible=false: canon rule from the Unstuck chair, 'Billy never vows; he drifts, and his serenity is acceptance, not faith'.

roll_refresh is the only seed_locked=false boon: it spends the visible Improbability resource to reroll, and its peeked variant is the Finite Improbability Generator, 'which in canon burns its users'. Every other boon's triggers ride the pure 2d6 seed curve.

Inefficiency Law encoded as arithmetic (F6): vow_multiplier is capped at 1.5 while the Vow price doubles vm_cost, so a pledged boon returns less power per VM than the war path's plain picks. If a meta optimizes Vow plus Seed into a dominant strategy, these numbers re-price.
Two boons per god_face, twelve total, preserving the MUD build's original twelve.
